errata_records.issue: Presence of competing legacy taxonomy arrays (primary_entity_types [11] and optional_extension_types [7]) alongside authoritative core_entity_types [8] and extension_entity_types [10].
errata_records.remediation: Legacy arrays moved to legacy_authoring_grouping with deprecated=true and taxonomy_authority=false. Authoritative taxonomy strictly defined by core_entity_types (8) and extension_entity_types (10) totaling exactly 18 entity types.
